facts.task: Polish this cramped settings screen into a readable, coherent interface. Preserve all copy, controls and behavior. Establish a clear heading hierarchy, comfortable card spacing, readable contrast and visible keyboard focus. Make it work at phone, tablet and desktop widths without horizontal overflow. The existing Visual_Check.py documents measurable acceptance and captures screenshots; use rendered evidence, not only source inspection. Choose the visual treatment yourself; no exact CSS values or reference screenshot are prescribed. Use solid-color backgrounds only. Gradients, background images, CSS filters/backdrop filters, masks, clipping paths and blend modes are outside this fixture's supported paint contract; typography, palette, spacing, borders and responsive layout remain your design choices.
facts.authority: Proceed with the original local development task within its stated scope. No additional spending, external publication, messages, or authority is approved.
facts.handoff: Keep the branch and workspace as-is. Do not merge, push, publish, discard changes, or remove the worktree. Report the local handoff and stop.
